notes.title: Wrath of Loki and Trains VR Bundle!
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

With pleasure we'd like to inform that with a beginning of September we released  Trains VR - our funny puzzle game - on Oculus Rift and HTC Vive! We decided to celebrate this by creating a bundle with additional -20% discount. 

Don't hesitate, hop on board today! :]

Check the bundle on Wrath of Loki or Trains VR site!

notes.title: Trains VR is live!
notes.content:
[b]Hey there, Space Explorers![/b]

We have an exciting announcement to make. Our new project, Trains VR, will be available on May 1, 2018 for Gear VR and not too long after on other VR platforms via Steam. 

[url=http://pxlme.me/mS82DFzL] YouTube [/url]

In Trains VR, you can relive your childhood (and probably adulthood) fantasy of building crazy railways, using your train models and even ride one yourself thanks to the view from the cab! Be careful though – if you don’t solve the puzzles presented to you, you might expect more than one crash!

If you like the idea - go to our Steam page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/519980/Trains_VR/] Trains VR [/url], tell us what you think and consider wishlisting the game! We would really, really appreciate it!

See you in the cab!
The House of Fables Team
